vocabulary.meaning_en: one of the four parts of the year
vocabulary.example: Which season do you like best?

vocabulary.meaning_en: the coldest season of the year
vocabulary.note_ar: نقول in winter أو in the winter.
vocabulary.note_en: We say in winter / in the winter.
vocabulary.example: It often snows in winter.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the season after winter, when plants start to grow
vocabulary.example: The trees are green in spring.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the warmest season of the year
vocabulary.example: Schools close in summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the season after summer, when leaves fall from trees
vocabulary.note_ar: fall أمريكية، و autumn أكثر استخدامًا في بريطانيا.
vocabulary.note_en: fall is American; autumn is more common in the UK.
vocabulary.example: The leaves turn red and yellow in the fall.

vocabulary.meaning_en: time away from work or school to rest or travel
vocabulary.note_ar: في بريطانيا: holiday. نقول go on vacation.
vocabulary.note_en: UK: holiday. We say go on vacation.
vocabulary.example: We are going on vacation in August.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the thing that people talk or write about
vocabulary.note_ar: تعني أيضًا مادة دراسية مثل math.
vocabulary.note_en: It also means a school subject, like math.
vocabulary.example: The subject of today's show is summer.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of work someone gives you to do
vocabulary.example: My new assignment is a children's show.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an idea of what you will do; to decide what you will do
vocabulary.example: What's the plan for tomorrow?

vocabulary.meaning_en: to present a subject or a person for the first time
vocabulary.example: First, I will introduce the subject.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to ask someone questions for a show or a job; a meeting with questions
vocabulary.example: We can interview the students.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you invite to your home or show
vocabulary.example: We have two guests on the show today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: children (informal)
vocabulary.note_ar: kid كلمة غير رسمية بمعنى child.
vocabulary.note_en: kid is an informal word for child.
vocabulary.example: The kids are playing in the garden.

vocabulary.meaning_en: staying outdoors in a tent for fun
vocabulary.example: We go camping in the mountains every year.

vocabulary.meaning_en: outside, not in a building
vocabulary.example: The children like to play outdoors.

vocabulary.meaning_en: taking long walks in nature
vocabulary.example: Hiking is good exercise.

vocabulary.meaning_en: catching fish
vocabulary.example: My father likes fishing at the lake.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a large park with rides and games
vocabulary.example: The amusement park is full of families.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine you sit on for fun at a park; to sit on and travel
vocabulary.example: This ride is very fast.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a soft pink or blue sweet made of sugar
vocabulary.example: The kids want cotton candy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a fast ride that goes up and down on a track
vocabulary.example: I am scared of the rollercoaster.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the sandy land next to the sea
vocabulary.note_en: Say it with a long ee sound: /biːtʃ/.
vocabulary.example: We walk on the beach in the evening.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very large area of sea water
vocabulary.example: The ocean is blue and deep.

vocabulary.meaning_en: right now, without waiting
vocabulary.example: Please come home immediately.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at a time after now
vocabulary.example: We'll think of a name later.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at this moment
vocabulary.example: Right now, it's time to work.

fine_lines.title: will vs be going to
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان للمستقبل. be going to للخطط التي قررناها من قبل: What are we going to talk about? أما will فللقرارات السريعة لحظة الكلام والوعود والتوقّعات: We'll think of a name later.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both talk about the future. Use be going to for plans you already have: What are we going to talk about? Use will for quick decisions, promises and predictions: We'll think of a name later.

examples.sentence: We are going to visit my aunt next week.
It's cold. I'll close the window.
She is going to study medicine.

fine_lines.title: autumn vs fall
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الكلمتان بمعنى الخريف. fall أكثر استخدامًا في أمريكا، و autumn في بريطانيا، وكلاهما صحيح.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean the season after summer. Americans often say fall; British people usually say autumn. Both are correct.

examples.sentence: The weather is cool in autumn.

expressions.meaning_en: saying which season you like most
expressions.example: My favorite season is spring because of the flowers.

expressions.phrase: Are you going on vacation this summer?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل ستذهب في إجازة هذا الصيف؟
expressions.example: Are you going on vacation this summer? — Yes, to the beach.

expressions.meaning_en: showing you feel sorry about some bad news
expressions.example: You can't come? That's too bad.
Let's walk to school. — Great idea!
This is a new game. Let's try it!

expressions.phrase: We'll think of a name later.
expressions.meaning_en: deciding to do something at a later time
expressions.example: We'll think of a title later.

expressions.meaning_en: saying something may happen in the future, not now
expressions.example: Can we go to the mountains? — Maybe next summer.

expressions.phrase: Right now, it's time to work!
expressions.meaning_en: saying it is time to start working
expressions.example: Lunch is over. Right now, it's time to work!

grammar.title: Future with be going to
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) نستخدم am / is / are + going to + الفعل الأصلي للخطط المستقبلية. 2) I am going to ... / She is going to ... / We are going to ... 3) النفي: نضيف not بعد am/is/are: I'm not going to travel. 4) السؤال: نقدّم am/is/are: Are you going to travel? 5) في الكلام السريع قد تسمع gonna بدل going to، لكن لا تكتبها في الكتابة الرسمية.
grammar.explanation_en: 1) Use am/is/are + going to + base verb for plans. 2) I am going to... / She is going to... / We are going to... 3) Negative: add not: I'm not going to travel. 4) Question: Are you going to travel? 5) In fast speech you may hear 'gonna', but write 'going to'.
examples: We are going to introduce the subject.
Anna is not going to travel this summer.
What are we going to talk about?
They're going to visit the beach.

grammar.title: Future with will
grammar.explanation_ar: 1) will + الفعل الأصلي للمستقبل، ومع كل الضمائر بنفس الشكل. 2) الاختصار: I'll, we'll, you'll, it'll. 3) النفي: will not = won't. 4) نستخدمها للقرار السريع والتوقّع: That will be fun!
grammar.explanation_en: 1) will + base verb for the future, the same for all subjects. 2) Short forms: I'll, we'll, it'll. 3) Negative: will not = won't. 4) Use it for quick decisions and predictions: That will be fun!

grammar.title: Ordering steps: first, then, finally
grammar.explanation_ar: لترتيب خطوات الخطة نستخدم: First (أولًا) ثم Then (بعد ذلك) ثم Finally (أخيرًا). مثال من الدرس: First, we're going to introduce the subject. Then we can show pictures. Finally, we can read the questions.
grammar.explanation_en: To put the steps of a plan in order, use First, then Then, and Finally for the last step.

questions.question: How many seasons does Washington, D.C. have?
questions.explanation_ar: لها أربعة فصول: الشتاء والربيع والصيف والخريف.
questions.explanation_en: It has four seasons: winter, spring, summer and fall.

questions.question: Which word means the same as 'autumn'?
questions.explanation_en: fall is the American word for autumn.

questions.question: We ____ going to interview children.
questions.explanation_ar: مع we نستخدم are going to.
questions.explanation_en: With we, use are going to.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد will يأتي الفعل الأصلي بدون s وبدون to.
questions.explanation_en: After will, use the base verb with no -s and no 'to'.

questions.question: Why is Anna not going on vacation this summer?
questions.explanation_ar: قالت: This summer I am too busy.
questions.explanation_en: She says, 'This summer I am too busy.'

questions.question: Where do you go on rides and eat cotton candy?
questions.explanation_ar: في مدينة الملاهي نركب الألعاب ونأكل غزل البنات.
questions.explanation_en: At an amusement park you go on rides and eat fun food.

questions.question: First, we introduce the subject. ____, we show pictures.
questions.explanation_ar: Then تأتي بعد First للخطوة التالية.
questions.explanation_en: Then comes after First for the next step.

questions.question: Your friend can't come on the trip. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: That's too bad تعبّر عن الأسف لخبر سيئ.
questions.explanation_en: That's too bad shows you are sorry about bad news.

questions.question: What does 'outdoors' mean?
questions.explanation_ar: outdoors تعني خارج المباني في الهواء الطلق.
questions.explanation_en: outdoors means outside, not in a building.

questions.question: Which sentence is a quick decision made now?
choices: I'm going to study medicine next year.
We are going to visit Paris in June.
They are going to move house.
It's dark. I'll turn on the light.
questions.explanation_en: will is used for a quick decision made at the moment of speaking.
